structuralFloorComparison.crackMethod: JRC Eurocode 2 worked examples, 2014, 7.3.4 form sr=3.4c+0.8*k2*0.425*bar/rhoeff. Deliberately neglect favourable tension-stiffening, full G+Q elastic cracked stress plus a separate 400microstrain upper restraint comparison using pure-tension k2=1.0. The 0.30mm is an authored structural comparison only, not acceptable gas transmission, liquid permeability or proof of lifetime crack width. Full restraint, unmodeled settlement and thermal exposure remain bounded hypotheses. https://eurocodes.jrc.ec.europa.eu/publications/eurocode-2-background-appications-design-concrete-buildings-worked-examples
structuralFloorComparison.pour: Preferred finite construction control: form a continuous upper200mm dry-floor lift (20.98m3 nominal), including the head/beam overlap once and the formed threshold seat. No planned full-depth intermediate joint in occupied field; if the lower grillage is cast first, structural horizontal construction interface is at underside -380 with prepared rough concrete and continuing reinforcement. Starter/interlock, real pour length, temperature/early-age restraint, interruption detail and any service penetrations still need coordinated design. Do not declare the construction joint airtight.
structuralFloorComparison.materials: C30/S500 only structural comparison. Composite RC density at or below25kN/m3 including the actual bars must be delivered for this load bound. Cement dose, constituent mix, permeability, curing, floor surface/air-wall seal and actual site/water exposure remain the material/source owners’ duties. 300kg/m3 or 40mm exposure hypothesis alone gives no admission.
structuralFloorComparison.scope: Only candidate thickness/cover comparisons. Actual mix, curing, crack/joint moisture/air/gas performance, floor/wall and renewable threshold construction remain unearned.
